beforeCompress.description: Preserve LitFolio project invariants before context compression

hooks.command:
cat <<'EOF'
Preserve these LitFolio invariants in compressed context:
- Tauri 2 + React/TypeScript frontend + Rust backend; pnpm is the package manager.
- Build/quality commands: pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint, pnpm test, pnpm build; backend tests from src-tauri via cargo test.
- IPC changes require synchronized Rust command registration, frontend api wrappers, schemas/parsers, mocks, and tests.
- DB changes require new SQLite migrations; do not edit shipped migrations.
- Release version sync: package.json, src-tauri/tauri.conf.json, src-tauri/Cargo.toml, src-tauri/Cargo.lock.
- Docs/release generated files should generally not be committed; only bundled manual PDFs under docs/ are allowed by project rules.
EOF
